D5 gripper pads use the same 2 ms stiff contact as the tabletop to resolve the thin cloth. Default mixed 12 ms contacts compressed the modeled sheet by 1-1.7 mm. Geometry, friction and actuator force limits are unchanged; material compliance still requires calibration.

CG uses 1000 iterations for articulated shells; independent cloth uses Newton. A 100-iteration CG probe failed to resolve stiff cloth constraints. This is a separately recorded runtime, not a re-evaluation of the frozen 3.10 demonstrations.

Optional grasp-retention assistance: local cloth vertices connect to the contacting robot after positive physical contact. All connections are explicitly released before final success. No prop-prop constraints, teleportation or friction changes. This episode is not a pure-contact or policy benchmark result.
